_note: Optional Code-Shield config. Place as `.codeshield.yml`/`codeshield.json` at a repo root to tune the scan. Everything is OFF by default (scan everything); this file only ever NARROWS scope — it can never make the scanner execute code or bypass redaction.
_comment_secrets: A file in allow_secrets_in still gets its value REDACTED in reports; this only suppresses the 'credential file present' banner for documented example files.
